title: ComfyUI workflow: animate characters/objects using LoRAs + video animation generator (full pipeline) for my game Demo
author: Nearby_Ad_3037
selftext:
I wanted to share a workflow I’ve been using in ComfyUI for generating consistent animations from LoRAs.

I’m using this in a real project — a historical game set during the Hussite Wars — mainly to prototype systems quickly before committing to final assets.

It could also animate objects, not just characters in every single. Every Lora is trained for different position so these consistent and it does not mess up anything.

And then you download it frame by frame with no background at all I hope this help 

Do you guys have any questions? Please ask.

The reason why i am doing this  is because I hate those payed corporations they just steal your money while you could do the exact same thing locally

comments.author: UneqMrCrow
comments.body:
I have a question out of curiosity. I should say first that I am quite ignorant about this subject, so I may be asking you an extremely stupid question. If I understood correctly, through this workflow you are able to animate both human characters and objects. My questions are:

- On what basis is the workflow able to infer the correct animation you want to implement?

- Would it also work with animations for fantasy characters with non-humanoid features?


Thank you.

replies.author: Nearby_Ad_3037
replies.body:
No, not at all. I actually like to help nothing that you ask is ignorance or stupid questions. 

For the first one, the workflow has a positive and negative which is a prompt. It’s on the left side of the screen that you cannot see that’s where you add the animation or what you wanted to do but if you zoom in in the model, there is exactly 7 different Loras each is trained for a specific animation idle, walking… they are  all named so it should be easy other than that everything else you see is to control and minimize mistakes colour or inconsistency…

And it can animate any characters and objects. Doesn’t matter what genre or art style it’s all based on animations.

replies.author: UneqMrCrow
replies.body: I have another question: during the animation, can it also add or remove elements? For example, imagine a dragon that at a certain point breathes fire from its mouth.

replies.author: Nearby_Ad_3037
replies.body: Yes absolutely you can there is an option at the bottom near the imagine step 2.5 which you can mask what you want to keep and everything else will be deleted and the other picture it deleted everything in the background to keep your character alone.
